name: browser-use
headline: Jta - JSON Translation Agent
short_description: Jta is an AI-powered JSON translation tool that uses agentic reflection with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs. It enables operations teams to automate JSON data translation for localization and i18n workflows. Connects to CLI tools and supports Go 1.25+.
author: hikanner

sections.overview:
Jta is a production-ready command-line tool that translates JSON internationalization files using agentic reflection, where AI translates, evaluates, and refines its own work across multiple quality dimensions. It supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs with automatic terminology detection to maintain brand consistency and robust format preservation for placeholders, HTML tags, URLs, and Markdown. The tool enables operations teams to automate localization workflows with incremental translation that only updates new or modified content, reducing API costs by 80-90% on updates. It handles 50+ languages including RTL support for Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian, and integrates directly with CLI tools and AI agents like Claude for seamless i18n automation.
Translate JSON i18n files to multiple languages automatically with quality assurance via agentic reflection
Update localization files incrementally while preserving existing high-quality translations
Maintain consistent terminology across translated content using automatic term detection
Integrate JSON translation into CI/CD pipelines for continuous localization workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/hikanner/jta`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
